latin: Per mysterium duarum litterarum uau et iod scitur quomodo ipse messias ut deus fuit principium suiipsius ut homo.
translation: The mystery of the two letters vav and yod shows how the Messiah, as God, was the origin of himself considered as man.
translation_note: Vav and yod are the first and last letters of the name Jesus in Pico's letter-play, as in 11>14 (farmer1998:27360).
